tools.name: inspect_pe_resources
tools.title: Inspect Pe Resources
tools.description: Inspect one explicit local PE32/PE32+ image's complete bounded type/name/language resource tree without executing it or opening a disassembler. Returns numeric IDs versus original UTF-16 names, directory/data-entry file locations, payload RVA/file ranges, complete SHA-256 hashes and static RT_GROUP_ICON image-resource candidates. Language fallback, image decoding and actual shell/window loading remain unobserved. Reads a stable regular file; malformed or ambiguous mappings, non-identical overlapping ranges and exhausted budgets return no partial success. Portable on supported Node hosts; no Windows SDK or engine installation required.

parameters.name: max_entries
parameters.description: Maximum resource directory entries to examine; exceeding the budget fails without partial success

parameters.name: max_file_bytes
parameters.description: Maximum stable artifact bytes to read (default 64 MiB)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute filesystem path to a PE image

tools.name: inspect_binary_layout
tools.title: Inspect Binary Layout
tools.description: Inspect an explicit local binary without launching it as a host process. Returns file-backed section/segment ranges, linked addresses, original symbol/REL/RELA table identities, complete encoded RELR tables and upstream-derived offsets with unknown per-word locations/addends, raw name bytes, dependency/interpreter names and static mitigation inferences inline with artifact SHA-256 Evidence. Initial profile: ELF64 x86-64 little-endian EXEC/DYN/REL on Linux x64 via caller-supplied Python with unchanged pwntools 4.15.0, pyelftools 0.33 and Unicorn 2.1.2. Runtime addresses/library paths, overall relocation inventory completeness and complete derived GOT/PLT coverage remain unknown. Zero executable entry values mean absence; relocatable entries are not applicable. Upstream can emulate PLT instructions with Unicorn for derived static maps. Uses bounded complete output and owned temporary files/processes; malformed, unsupported or oversized objects return no partial success. Select detail summary to retain the complete layout Evidence in this session and receive only its summary view, then inspect sections, symbols, mitigations or linkage with inspect_analysis_view.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute filesystem path to the selected binary

tools.name: inspect_recorded_crash
tools.title: Inspect Recorded Crash
tools.description: Inspect a supplied Linux ELF64 amd64 or AArch64 little-endian core without launching its target or attaching to any live PID. Returns all recorded segments, raw note owners/descriptors and source ranges, every Linux CORE PRSTATUS thread/register and SIGINFO fields inline with SHA-256 Evidence. Historical PID is recorded metadata; current process/file identity, note coverage and signal-thread associations stay unknown. Optionally add derived core-only GDB/pwndbg mapping candidates through explicit BYO configuration; zero map flags mean unknown permissions. Uses the same stable snapshot for both stages, bounded complete output and owned cleanup. Linux x64 host profile: unchanged pwntools 4.15.0/pyelftools 0.33/Unicorn 2.1.2; optional unchanged pwndbg 2026.09.15. No implicit executable/library pairing, GDB command language, host configuration changes or dependency installation.

parameters.name: include_debugger_context
parameters.description: Add core-only mapping candidates through caller-supplied GDB/pwndbg

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute filesystem path to a supplied Linux ELF core

tools.name: inspect_analysis_view
tools.title: Inspect Analysis View
tools.description: Inspect selected views of completed binary-layout, JavaScript application, native analyze_function, inspect_artifact, inventory_artifact, inspect_wasm_artifact, inspect_macho, inspect_evm_interface, inspect_managed_artifact, inspect_android_package, inspect_dart_aot or inspect_web_network_capture Evidence without repeating analysis. Historical capture summaries return identity and counts without bodies or archive inventories. Capture views page retained records: view {kind: "capture", detail: "preview" | "complete", offset: 0, limit: 20}; preview selects recorded headline fields and binary descriptors, complete returns exact records with all sidecars. Offsets follow the selected parent record order, preserving original producer ordinals. Paging never reopens the source or reruns the decoder. For inspect_pcap_capture parents, kind pcap pages endpoints, dns-queries, tls-sni, protocols, http-uris or unattributed-addresses. Select an exact query for dns-addresses, or a tshark/capinfos stream for UTF-16 diagnostics text. Page totals count retained facts; source coverage remains explicit. Qlog summaries keep profile/scope and counts; kind qlog pages traces, streams, loss-declarations, incomplete-records, contributions, ranges or final-sizes. Except traces, select trace_index; stream-specific facets also require exact stream_id and direction. Facts retain all-recorded-events-before-s…

parameters.name: view
parameters.type: object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object

tools.name: inspect_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Artifact
tools.description: Inspect an active archive or application package in one call. By default returns the complete content-addressed artifact graph once, as the typed nested inventory Evidence, with root and integrity observations, integrity contradictions, hypotheses, unexplored branches, limitations, and next probes inline. Optional detail summary retains the complete inspection and returns its derived summary view; read exact paths or inventory pages with inspect_analysis_view using parent_evidence_id. This changes delivery, not inventory coverage. Read-only DMG mounting is used automatically on supported macOS hosts. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue keeps mismatches explicitly untrusted. It does not extract files; use extract_artifact to materialize its regular contents.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete inspection Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for inventory views.

tools.name: extract_artifact
tools.title: Extract Artifact
tools.description: Extract all regular files from the active archive or application package into a fresh temporary directory chosen by REA. The result includes its location. Rejects traversal and symlink escapes, never overwrites, and verifies cleanup. Integrity mismatches fail by default; record-and-continue extracts the observed bytes and returns each mismatch as an explicitly untrusted integrity contradiction.

tools.name: decode_interface_builder
tools.title: Decode Interface Builder
tools.description: Decode compiled storyboard and nib archives inside the active Apple app bundle, including keyed property lists and NIBArchive object tables, into a bounded object, hierarchy, and connection graph. This is static archive parsing; unrecognized archive classes and unresolved code handlers remain explicit unknowns.

parameters.name: max_objects

tools.name: inspect_keyed_archive
tools.title: Inspect Keyed Archive
tools.description: Inspect one Foundation NSKeyedArchiver plist in the active app bundle as original object-table nodes, class descriptors, named roots, and UID edges. Preserves shared and cyclic references without instantiating classes. The path is relative to the bundle; root selection and object pagination preserve original identities.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Local filesystem path used by this operation.

tools.name: inspect_asset_catalog
tools.title: Inspect Asset Catalog
tools.description: Inspect compiled Assets.car metadata in an active Apple app bundle. Returns stable paginated catalog and rendition records with raw assetutil metadata and catalog digests; rendition bytes are not extracted.

tools.name: trace_dylib_resolution
tools.title: Trace Dylib Resolution
tools.description: Trace how dyld would resolve each Mach-O dylib load for the active Mach-O, or for every executable in the active .app bundle (the main app, XPC services, extensions, login items, helpers). Expands @executable_path, @loader_path, and @rpath through each process's LC_RPATH stack in dependents-first load order, and reports every candidate path with its outcome, the resolved image and digest, weak, re-export, and upward flags, and derived findings such as unresolved required loads or absent earlier @rpath candidates. Pure header parsing: nothing is executed, and absolute or system paths outside the analyzed root stay undetermined. Select roots or one architecture to narrow large bundles.

tools.name: inspect_evm_interface
tools.title: Inspect Evm Interface
tools.description: Inspect explicit local flat EVM bytecode without target execution or chain/RPC access. Select raw or hex encoding explicitly. Omitted or complete detail returns original carrier and decoded identities, full bytecode and all inferred interface candidates inline. For all inferred selectors/offsets/arguments/mutability and identities without bytecode hex or duplicated stdout, select detail: "summary" on this first call: it retains unchanged complete Evidence and returns a distinct linked inspect_analysis_view summary. Read original function rows or bytecode_hex/stdout/stderr text pages using view kind evm and normalized_result.parent_evidence_id; original complete Evidence remains accessible. Bytecode kind, hardfork, deployed authenticity and discovery completeness stay unknown; summary coverage covers only producer-returned candidates. Unchanged bundled EVMole 0.9.3/WASM in an owned bounded worker is initially real-verified on Linux x64; EOF-style EF00 containers are unsupported. No signature lookup, wallet action or transaction broadcast.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Raw bytes or UTF-8 hex with optional 0x prefix and outer ASCII whitespace

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path to caller-selected local bytecode carrier

tools.name: inspect_go_binary
tools.title: Inspect Go Binary
tools.description: Inspect embedded Go compiler version, main module, dependency/replacement versions and build settings in an explicit local ELF, PE or thin Mach-O image. Returns original artifact SHA-256, exact build-info source ranges, raw framed module bytes and unparsed module-text lines inline as observed Evidence. Supports inline and historical pointer encodings without installing Go, opening a disassembler, executing the target, writing temporary files or accessing the network. Missing metadata is reported as unknown, not proof that an image is not Go. Does not recover functions, source mappings, types or runtime behavior. Resource guards bound files to 256 MiB, aggregate embedded strings to 1 MiB, structural table decoding to 16 MiB and complete inline metadata to 8 MiB; malformed, unsupported and oversized inputs receive typed failures rather than partial success.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute filesystem path to the selected executable or library

tools.name: inspect_wasm_artifact
tools.title: Inspect Wasm Artifact
tools.description: Validate an explicit local WASM artifact with caller-supplied WABT 1.0.42. Omitted or complete detail returns exact byte SHA-256, sections, upstream import/export WAT forms and decoded WAT inline as Evidence. For counts, validation and WAT identity without WAT text, pass detail: "summary" on this first call; it retains the complete original Evidence and returns the same typed summary as inspect_analysis_view, avoiding oversized complete delivery. Read exact imports/exports or WAT pages with inspect_analysis_view using normalized_result.parent_evidence_id. Delivery selection does not change analysis, provider inputs or source identity. Optionally associate selected JavaScript glue literals with explicit local candidates while preserving ambiguous URL/basename matches. Configure absolute REA_WABT_BIN_DIRECTORY. No installation, implicit fetch, WASM execution or original-source claim.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute selected local WASM artifact path

tools.name: compare_wasm_interfaces
tools.title: Compare Wasm Interfaces
tools.description: Compare typed core WASM import/export names, kinds and exact signatures from two authenticated inspect_wasm_artifact Evidence records. Select imports, exports or both explicitly. Retained references resolve only in the current session; CLI accepts portable inline Evidence. Duplicate names, unsupported types and missing historical interface facets remain unknown. Preserve original module digests and every occurrence; no source acquisition, module execution or runtime-compatibility inference.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Exact complete inspect_wasm_artifact Evidence or retained session reference

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Exact complete inspect_wasm_artifact Evidence or retained session reference

parameters.name: scope

tools.name: inspect_sqlite_database
tools.title: Inspect Sqlite Database
tools.description: Inspect an explicit local SQLite database snapshot and its existing sibling WAL without modifying source files or opening a native analysis provider. Requires Node.js 24.x >=24.15 or 26+ with native DatabaseSync.limits support, checked by the worker. Returns observed Evidence with database/WAL SHA-256 and a compact schema inventory. Selecting an exact ordinary table expands only its schema and samples rows (default 20, subject to byte and worker resource limits). Select exact columns in the requested order to avoid unrelated or large values; schema_scope=database explicitly expands the whole schema; returned rows retain 64-bit integers, text bytes and blobs with explicit truncation. No arbitrary SQL, view or virtual-table execution, extension loading, database repair, encryption support or live-snapshot atomicity claim. At most two inspections per provider are admitted; occupied capacity is retryable. An isolated temporary copy and owned worker enforce input, value/record, SQL-statement, JSON-reply, JavaScript-heap and deadline limits; overall native heap is not capped. Supply a quiescent snapshot for coherent database/WAL evidence.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Exact row columns in caller-selected order; requires table. Omit to sample all visible columns.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute path to an offline SQLite database snapshot

parameters.name: row_limit
parameters.description: Selected-table sample size, default 20; subject to byte and worker resource limits

parameters.name: schema_scope
parameters.description: Default: compact inventory without a table, or detailed selected-table schema with a table. Database explicitly expands all stored declarations and supported columns.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Exact ordinary table name; views and virtual/shadow tables are not executed

tools.name: inspect_packet_fields
tools.title: Inspect Packet Fields
tools.description: Discover protocols or field names/types registered in the installed TShark 4.x. kind defaults to protocols; use fields and optional exact protocol abbreviation to select field definitions. query searches name/abbreviation/description by case-insensitive literal substring. Return 50 matches by default with offset/limit paging; null requests all remaining within resource limits. Preserve type/base/bitmask/description, duplicate registrations, source line numbers, coverage, tool identity and diagnostics. Linux, REA_TSHARK_COMMAND and prlimit required. No capture file, interface or binary target needed. Registrations describe tool capabilities, not observed traffic. Each call rereads the glossary; use selected fields with inspect_packet_capture.

tools.name: inspect_packet_capture

tools.description: Inspect caller-selected fields in an existing local packet capture with TShark 4.x. Return 50 matching frames by default, with match_offset/match_limit paging and coverage counts; match_limit:null requests all remaining matches. Preserve repeated values, frame numbers, display filter, decode-as rules and pass mode in inline Evidence with source/tool identity and diagnostics. Optional packet_limit counts input packets before filtering; output paging does not shorten dissection or two-pass reassembly. Requires Linux, util-linux prlimit, and absolute REA_TSHARK_COMMAND. File-only analysis; no live capture or device communication. Missing fields or no matches do not establish absence of device traffic.

tools.name: inspect_signal_decoders
tools.title: Inspect Signal Decoders
tools.description: Discover installed sigrok protocol decoders or inspect one decoder's channel/option help on Linux. Omit decoder to list ID/name pairs; supply its exact ID for literal help lines with source line numbers. query is a case-insensitive literal substring. Page matches with offset/limit (default 50; null returns all remaining). Reports tool identity, version, diagnostics and examined/matching coverage. Uses configured REA_SIGROK_COMMAND and prlimit; no recording, binary target, hardware scan or acquisition. Each call probes again; decoder modules are trusted, not fully fingerprinted. Use returned IDs/options with decode_signal_recording.

Supply decoder stack, channels and options explicitly; optionally select input format and annotation classes. Return 50 literal output lines by default, with line_offset/line_limit paging; line_limit:null requests all remaining lines. Output windows count display lines, not annotations or samples, and do not shorten decoding. Preserve selected text, sample ranges, stderr, source/tool identity and coverage inline. It retains complete Evidence and returns a distinct linked inspect_analysis_view summary. Page original references/resources/attributes with view kind managed and normalized_result.parent_evidence_id. Counts cover producer-returned rows; partial, unavailable or malformed metadata remains explicit and tokens remain build-local.

Select type_names to decode only the members of those exact declaring types, which keeps large assemblies such as a base class library within the representation budget. Metadata tokens are reported as build-local coordinates bound to the artifact SHA-256 and MVID; the tuple hash does not resolve them or fully commit control flow.

String-pool entries are byte-pattern observations, not deserialized cluster semantics; typed class and function recovery needs an SDK-specific parser. Omitted or complete detail returns the full observation. Select detail: "summary" for target/ABI/library identity, all snapshot headers, coverage and original lower-bound counts without string lists. The complete source stays retained; read returned strings via inspect_analysis_view with parent_evidence_id and kind dart-aot, collection package_uris/dart_uris/class_like_tokens, offset and limit. Exhausting pages does not imply complete pool coverage. No engine, no execution.

tools.name: trace_web_source_location
tools.title: Trace Web Source Location
tools.description: Trace one generated position in an exported website script through an explicitly paired local source map. Verifies manifest, selected script and map SHA-256/byte identities; returns every equal-position mapping, reported source/root, resolved source URL, embedded sourcesContent and original position inline. One-based lines and zero-based UTF-16 columns; greatest generated position <= requested across lines. Duplicate sources and generated-only mappings remain distinct. Caller-selected pairing does not establish deployment authenticity or execution. Regular maps and inline indexed sections only; external section URLs are unsupported. No network access or application execution; uses the pinned upstream codec in an owned Node process with private temporary files, independent 192 MiB old-generation heap and 20-second deadline. 4 MiB map, 32 MiB reply; complete evidence or actionable resource failure. Cleanup may extend the deadline.

parameters.name: script_index

tools.name: trace_web_module_imports

Query/fragment identities are preserved. Computed imports and bundler IDs remain unknown. Select importer_url for unknown inline/document-base context. Caller-supplied Chromium executes only a trusted REA resolver stub in an owned context with page requests locally fulfilled/blocked; no captured application execution or asset refetch. Requires absolute REA_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE for literal imports. 32 MiB manifest, 16 MiB source, 4 MiB map and 20-second native deadline; cleanup may extend the deadline.

tools.name: inspect_web_network_capture
tools.title: Inspect Web Network Capture
tools.description: Request detail summary for capture identity and counts; then page retained records with inspect_analysis_view kind capture (preview or complete), avoiding repeated decoding. Default detail complete preserves existing inline delivery. Inspect retained local HAR 1.2, native mitmproxy, Fiddler SAZ or aioquic 1.5.0 JSON qlog 0.3 events without contacting recorded URLs. Returns original ordinals, pointers/byte ranges/archive member names, preserved producer fields, precise numeric representations and exact exposed binary bytes inline. Excludes known transport credentials and explicitly marked values. Decodes every record before optional ordinal selection; malformed or oversized captures return no partial success. Duplicate JSON members are invalid; prototype-named members such as __proto__ are preserved as ordinary own JSON members without prototype mutation. Qlog reports trace-scoped STREAM interval unions and endpoint loss declarations; it does not recover bodies, prove network loss or correlate PCAP. Other qlog layouts are unsupported. Uses pinned upstream parsers, owned temporary files and bounded offline processes. SAZ preserves HTTP fields, XML metadata and encoded body/message bytes without replay or HAR conversion; encrypted archives are unsupported. Native mitmproxy requires caller-supplied mitmdump 12.2.3 on Linux. Browser transaction IDs, runtime attribution and original…

An optional analysis snapshot is imported atomically and must match the binary identity, concrete provider, and canonical analysis profile exactly; importing into a session with metadata mutations requires closing and reopening it first.

tools.name: capture_process_scenario
tools.title: Capture Process Scenario
tools.description: Run one caller-selected command under a PTY and return process capture Evidence with residual unknowns. The renderer admits at most 1,000,000 combined terminal cells, computed as columns × (rows + scrollback); every resize uses the selected scrollback and must fit the same budget. Supply a smaller terminal shape when that product is too large; dimensions are never clamped. A command name resolves through the inherited PATH; the working directory defaults to the caller's current directory; host environment variables are inherited with scenario overrides. Environment keys cannot contain '=' or NUL, and REA_PROCESS_RUN_ID is reserved for process ownership. Filesystem snapshots are opt-in through filesystem_observation_paths. A positive finalization_ms makes a timeout or idle deadline send SIGTERM to the captured root through its start identity, keep observing, and send SIGKILL once after the interval; exit.finalization records each attempt with its delivery result and the observed exit, and cancellation still ends the run at once. The target runs with the current user's permissions; this is not a security sandbox.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Command name or executable path to run.

parameters.name: finalization_ms
parameters.description: Milliseconds a target may keep running after SIGTERM when timeout_ms or idle_timeout_ms fires, before SIGKILL; 0 sends SIGKILL immediately. Both signals reach the captured root only while its launch-time start identity still matches; cancellation ends the run at once.

parameters.name: limits
parameters.description: Resource budgets that bound execution and retained output for this operation.

parameters.name: terminal
parameters.description: The visible terminal and scrollback together must use at most 1,000,000 xterm renderer cells: columns × (rows + scrollback). Resize events use the same scrollback and limit.
